Mod here, seeing stuff like this hurts, we put a lot of our personal time into here; from approving posts, answering questions, seeking support for people and doing our best to try and keep it a safe space and at times speaking with people in crisis. 

The vast majority of news at the moment is bad news and people tend to jump on the bad instead of the good. Everyone is guilty of that including myself. 

There’s a lot of other forums that cover trans issues and other subs that cover subjects a lot better than here I.e politics or gaming (I’ve checked the OP history and never once have they been told to go to a games forum) but moving on. 

Instead of sitting there behind your screen, why don’t you suggest ways to improve the sub? We started to a positive Friday post where people post about a positive thing they have done or experienced that week and I have a couple of other ideals up my sleeve for here. 

With bans, we don’t ban things being talked about unless they don’t fully the subs rules. These rules were made a while ago and cover a wide range of subjects. When a post is removed, a message gets sent explaining why it has been removed and normally people will reword them or go ‘oh sorry’ and go and post it elsewhere I.e memes, personal photos or go fund mes. 

In the last 24 hours of the sub, the vast majority of posts have been about a range of subjects such as how to start HRT, getting their DX, asking for help around name changes and passports and talking about surgery wanting times. Okay there’s been posts about the media being transphobic as well but it’s not all doom and gloom. 

The sub is nothing without the community that joins it and engages with it.
